objective: The fight presentation pass: impact effects (hit-stop, sparks, camera punch, bigger flinch, power-attack charge and landing), visible arrows and spell bolts for archers and mages, per-species animal attacks with a win pose and a defeat reaction, and fight rhythm (a slow-motion beat on the killing blow, a power-attack camera cut-in, a skip button). Display only: no result, payout or log may change.
acceptance_criteria: A fight's result, payout and replay log are unchanged for the same wave and team (BattleRules and LevelRules specs still pass; won and seconds match before and after in Studio)
A hit shows a spark, a bigger flinch on the target and a camera punch, a power attack a charge and a landing effect, with a short hit-stop that never changes the server timing
Archers and mages fire a visible arrow or spell bolt that lands when the log says
Every animal and variant has its own attack clip (with a fallback), and the surviving team shows a win pose
A slow-motion beat on the killing blow and a power-attack camera cut-in, and a skip button that leaves the fight through wave_done
No script errors, effects cleaned up after a fight, and desktop frame time not noticeably worse with 3 vs 3 fighters
verification: All three slices built and checked in Studio on 2026-11-14: lune 687/687, selene and stylua clean, admin test waves 2, 3 and 6 with no script errors, effects cleaned up, wave 6 unchanged (won, 32s, 65 attacks), camera cut-ins and the killing blow measured on a wave 6 fight, flamingo legs measured planted. Not measured: frame time before/after, phones, wave 10 and bosses, two players. Not judged by eye: the clips in motion at full speed, the slow motion.
notes: Slices 1 (impact, shots, skip), 2 (per-species attacks, win pose, defeat knock-up) and 3 (slow-motion killing blow, camera cut-ins), plus a power attack for every base animal, done (decision 0048). Open: per-variant attacks and power attacks (a variant adds its own clip under its asset name); phones, a Drake or Dragon in the arena, two players, frame time.
